java_locations.role: Builds a UFont from the requested physical family, complete face (weight plus italic axis), and point size.
Resolves the requested face to a Java AWT Font before measurement.
Measures SVG text with FontMetrics.getStringBounds using fractional metrics.
Uses the same face-aware AWT font for width, height, and descent.

rust_locations.role: Does not recognize Times New Roman, falls back to Sans, and drops the italic axis from width measurement even though SVG emission carries font-style.
Passes family and bold state to layout measurement but not the resolved italic face.
Existing checked-in Java AWT extractor provides the provenance path for physical-family line metrics; it currently prints only an M advance rather than the complete printable-ASCII table.

claimed_invariant: A resolved physical font family and face are one measurement input. Layout widths, line heights, baselines, emitted textLength, and SVG face attributes all derive from the same Times New Roman plain/bold/italic/bold-italic AWT metrics.
causal_divergence: Rust emits Times New Roman italic SVG attributes but measures those runs with sans-serif non-italic tables. At 18px, the held-out state labels therefore use widths such as 125.6221 instead of Java's 106.9805, changing self-link loops, ordinary routes, node positions, painted bounds, and canvas dimensions. This is a family/face model omission, not a state-layout constant.

derivation.method: Java AWT Graphics2D with TEXT_ANTIALIAS_ON and FRACTIONALMETRICS_ON; printable ASCII advances sampled at 2048px so the resulting integer font units scale exactly at arbitrary sizes.

planned_model_change: Extend the checked-in extractor to emit printable-ASCII units for all four faces. Add Times New Roman face tables and symbolic 2048-unit line metrics to the shared text metric model. Thread italic through internal segment widths and add a face-aware public measurement entry point while preserving existing non-italic APIs. Make state transition, autonomous, and node measurement pass their resolved face. Do not add per-label values or state-specific geometry adjustments.
perturbation_axes: plain versus bold versus italic versus bold-italic face
transition labels versus state titles and attributes
ASCII punctuation, digits, uppercase, and lowercase
acceptance: The known Times New Roman italic counterexample is structurally equivalent.
Fresh face and text-content perturbations match Java without per-input constants.
Shared metric unit tests validate representative advances and line metrics from the extractor.
The full renderer library suite passes.
An independent checker records a verdict at the exact implementation revision.
